name: Rummy 500
tagline: Meld from the pile, lay off on anyone's melds, and race to 500.
rulesSummary: Deal 7 cards each (13 with two players). Each turn, draw from the stock — or take any card from the discard pile along with every card on top of it.
If you take more than the top card, you must meld the deepest one this turn.
Meld sets (3–4 of a rank, different suits) and runs (3+ in a suit; ace high or low, not both), and lay off on anyone's melds. Then discard.
Jokers are wild: say which card each one stands for (it can't change later). A set still can't have more than four cards.

Rummy! If a discard leaves a card in the pile that could be melded or laid off without anyone's hand, any other player may call Rummy! before the next draw: they take the pile down to it, must meld it, and play carries on from them.
Cards you meld or lay off score for you: aces and jokers 15 (an ace is 1 in A-2-3), faces 10, others their number. When someone goes out, cards left in hand count against you.
First past 500 wins. Two decks (four jokers) are used for five or more players.
